resources.string:
1. Tap "Enable keyboard" and switch on ZidnyKeyboard.
2. Tap "Choose keyboard" and pick ZidnyKeyboard.
3. Try typing in the box below, tap "→ EN" to choose the language to translate into and the tone (Casual, Polite or Formal), then tap "Terjemahkan" (Translate). If the sentence is already in that language (for example messy English), the button fixes its grammar instead.
4. Set the theme, layout and size of the keyboard below. Hold a letter for upper/lower case, symbols and accented letters, slide along the space bar to move the cursor, tap 📋 to paste something you copied before, 😊 for emoji, 🧮 for the calculator and ⚙️ to open this page. Tap 文A to translate text like Google Translate. Copy a message you received and tap 🔍 to see what it means, or 💬 (switch it on below) for suggested replies in the sender's language. The translation bar hides itself after 3 seconds; tap 🌐 to bring it back. If the system buttons cover the bottom row, raise "Space below the keyboard". Changes show on the keyboard straight away.
5. Translation needs an internet connection.
Keep a history of copied text (📋 on the keyboard)
Capital letter at the start of a sentence
Double space types a full stop
Fix typos automatically (tap delete to undo)
Translate copied messages into Indonesian (text is sent to the translation server)
Show the translation before replacing the text
Show what the translation means in Indonesian
Hide the translation bar after 3 seconds (tap 🌐 to show it again)
💬 button with suggested replies to a copied message (text is sent to the translation server)
Remember the language and tone for each app
Tap 🎤 on the keyboard, speak in Indonesian, and the result is translated straight away.
Word list for suggestions: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave (CC BY-SA 4.0), from OpenSubtitles.
The keyboard closed itself because of an error. Copy the report and send it to the developer so it can be fixed.
